name: Barnes-Hut Fast Summation
aliases: Barnes-Hut Fast Summation for Primal Queries
definition: An algorithm to accelerate the evaluation of dipole sums (Equations 17 and 20) for geometry and radiance fields by approximating the contribution of distant clusters of points using a single centroid, reducing complexity from O(N) to O(log N).
summary: Barnes-Hut Fast Summation accelerates dipole sum evaluation for geometry and radiance fields by approximating distant point clusters with centroids, reducing complexity from O(N) to O(log N).
